Class WorkspaceManagerImpl

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.workspace.manager.WorkspaceManagerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
WorkspaceManager
public class WorkspaceManagerImpl extends Object implements WorkspaceManager
Translates the public WorkspaceManager API into calls on the module's two internal, use-case-grouped service classes.
